rule: Raw bars must pass deterministic OHLC/time validation
UP inclusion uses max high and max low
DOWN inclusion uses min high and min low
Incomplete third bar cannot confirm fractal
RELAXED_LATE requires at least three raw bars between extreme sources
Tied extreme sources use conservative minimum spacing
Active same-type more-extreme endpoint keeps ID and increments revision
Finalized stroke is not rewritten by later active extension
Stroke structural and confirmation timestamps are distinct
